newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Top Russian ministers plan joint news conference.
newsitem.headline: Top Russian ministers plan joint news conference.

text.p: The top three members of Russia's new government will hold a news conference on Wednesday and Itar-Tass news agency said the final names in the government team were likely to be revealed.
"The line-up of the new cabinet is expected to be announced at the news conference," Tass said.
Government spokesman Igor Shabdurasulov said Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and First Deputy Prime Ministers Anatoly Chubais and Boris Nemtsov would brief the media on Wednesday afternoon.

"In the last two weeks, large parts of the government have worked round-the-clock in connection with the reorganisation of the government and the union protests on March 27," Shabdurasulov told a news conference.
Trade unions have called a nationwide day of protest on Thursday against delays of up to several months in payment of wages in many state sectors.
Chubais and Nemtsov are the two most prominent appointees in the new government. Both have pledged to speed up economic reforms and Nemtsov has promised to restructure powerful Russian monopolies.
